verdict.rationale: LM Studio's local-first design keeps data on the device: models run locally, document chat works entirely offline (lm-studio-docs-7), and Bionic voice data is processed locally and never leaves the device (lm-studio-docs-32). This architecturally keeps user data away from model trainers, but the evidence contains no explicit statement that user data is never used for training. It is also unclear whether Bionic's frontier-model mode runs locally. missing for 10: explicit no-training / data-usage policy, clarity on whether Bionic frontier-model use keeps data local, statements on telemetry, independent corroboration.
